results.title: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm’s actions since LIV Golf announcement have been totally bizarre
results.description: Nobody really knows what the future holds for LIV Golf duo Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm. DeChambeau joined LIV Golf from the PGA Tour way back in June 2022, while Rahm made the same move 18 months later.

results.title: The Chiefs revamped their running back room. I still have two questions
